description:
optional, enumerated string filter
Entity Type of the record. Possible values are : customer, subscription, invoice, credit_note, transaction, order.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → entity_type[is] = "customer"

is.description: \* \`customer\` - Entity that represents a customer \* \`subscription\` - Entity that represents a subscription of a customer \* \`invoice\` - Invoice description \* \`credit_note\` - Credit note description \* \`transaction\` - Entity that represents a transaction. \* \`order\` - Entity that represents an order

is_not.description: \* \`customer\` - Entity that represents a customer \* \`subscription\` - Entity that represents a subscription of a customer \* \`invoice\` - Invoice description \* \`credit_note\` - Credit note description \* \`transaction\` - Entity that represents a transaction. \* \`order\` - Entity that represents an order
